parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, slug, score_threshold, default_role,
  prompt_template, success_subject, success_body, reject_subject, reject_body,
  client_found
FROM (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.score_threshold, c.default_role,
    sp.prompt_template,
    et_s.subject AS success_subject, et_s.body AS success_body,
    et_r.subject AS reject_subject, et_r.body AS reject_body,
    true AS client_found,
    1    AS sort_order
  FROM clients c
  JOIN scoring_prompts sp
    ON sp.client_id = c.id AND sp.active = true
  LEFT JOIN email_templates et_s
    ON et_s.client_id = c.id AND et_s.template_type = 'success'
  LEFT JOIN email_templates et_r
    ON et_r.client_id = c.id AND et_r.template_type = 'rejection'
  WHERE c.slug = $1 AND c.active = true
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         false, 2
) q
ORDER BY sort_order ASC
LIMIT 1

Postgres — Load Client Config.setupNote: Create a Postgres credential named '[Recruitment] Supabase Postgres' using your Supabase project's connection string (Settings → Database → Connection string → URI). See SETUP.md for required tables: clients, scoring_prompts, email_templates.

_meta.codeNodeContext: n8n Code nodes use step-through require() for built-in Node.js modules (crypto, etc.) — valid n8n sandbox syntax. Not Vercel Workflow scope.
_meta.activationNote: Activate 00-error-handler FIRST. Then activate this workflow. Webhook URL after activation: https://[YOUR_N8N_INSTANCE]/webhook/recruitment/intake. Set this as your Typeform form's webhook endpoint. Configure the HMAC secret (Settings → Webhooks in Typeform) and set it as the TYPEFORM_HMAC_SECRET environment variable in n8n (Settings → Variables).
